en: Umm...Kaede!
Wh-What?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta looks mad! Did I do something
to make him angry?
Ummm, uhhh...
Y-Y-Your paw, please...!
My paw? Do I look like a dog to you?
Huh? D-Did Gonta mess up!?

I-It's okay, I'm sure this is some sort of
misunderstanding...
Were you asking me for my hand, Gonta?

Of course! Cuz Kaede is lady, so Gonta give
you escort like true gentleman!

Oh, I see now. You meant to say, "Your hand,
please."
Huh? Gonta thought he did say that...
Did Gonta use wrong word? Sorry!
Don't worry, you don't have to apologize...

U-Um... Last time Gonta spend time with
Kaede, Gonta just keep talking...

Gonta never escort you like gentleman.
So Gonta wanna do it right today...

But Gonta very nervous... Never escort
lady before...

But Gonta gentleman!
So Gonta give you proper escort!
Th-Thank you...
Okay, then...y-y-your hand, m'lady!
<CLT=cltMIND>He stuttered just now...
A-Again! Your hand, m-my lady!

<CLT=cltMIND>Hm? What should I say to help him calm
down?

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I guess I should just take his hand
for now.
Thank you very much, Gonta.
Wha—!?
A-Amazing! Kaede, you wonderful lady!
N-Not really...

<CLT=cltMIND>His eyes are practically sparkling, but I hope
he doesn't expect too much from me!
Ummmm...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta froze while he held my hand.
Don't tell me...

Kaede, what Gonta should do next?
Gonta not know...
<CLT=cltMIND>I knew it!

Me neither...I don't know what a gentleman
and a lady do at a time like this.
...Oh! Yes! Dance! We gotta dance!

Ladies and gentleman have night parties!
Lots of spinning and dancing!

That does sound right, but I don't think we
should be doing that right now...

Besides, I've never been to a social event
that involved dancing.
Gonta...also never dance before...
Ummmm... Then...then...!

<CLT=cltMIND>Between his wild hair and intense effort...
Gonta looks really scary right now!

So sorry! Gonta no can think of anything! Gonta
no can treat you like proper gentleman would!

U-Um, Gonta. You don't need to treat me
like a gentleman would.
B-But—!
Now, now, just listen to what I have to say.

Just letting you hold my hand is already
making me feel very safe, okay?
...Huh?

A gentleman is always supposed to protect
a lady, right?
I feel like your large hands are protecting me.
Really...?

Yeah, and I think that's very gentlemanly
of you.
K-Kaede...!

Thank you! Gonta so happy to be called
gentleman!
Your words give Gonta courage!

Gonta have lots to learn... But Gonta
do his best to become true gentleman!
Yeah, good luck!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm glad I was able to help him...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Gonta's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Gonta, I returned
to my room.
